Overview.Name: Swapna N
Overview.Goal: Weight loss while improving energy, gut comfort, and hormone balance with focus on appearance, confidence, health, and mental wellbeing.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 whole eggs pan fried + 1 small bowl fruit (papaya or banana)
Idli + 2 eggs omelette (skip chutneys with too much oil)
Meal_2_Lunch: Rice + fish curry/chicken curry + cooked vegetables
Grilled chicken + rice + cucumber and carrot
Egg rice + cooked beans or greens
Meal_3_Dinner: Chicken curry + cooked vegetables (beans, carrot, cabbage)
Snack_Optional_If_Hungry: Puffed rice with salt and onion (small bowl)
Lemon water or buttermilk without curd (use diluted milk option)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid curd as requested to prevent gas issues and digestive discomfort.
For thyroid and vertigo: include fish and iodised salt in meals for iodine and omega-3 support.
Gas control: avoid raw onion, heavy dals, deep-fried foods that trigger digestive issues.
Cook everything with minimal oil and avoid seed oils completely.
Eat slowly and stop when satisfied to support digestion and weight loss.
Savory fried cravings: replace with grilled or air-fried options for healthier alternatives.
Make sure each meal has a clear protein source (meat, eggs, dal) for satiety and muscle preservation.
Fill half plate with vegetables to improve fullness and nutrient density.
Keep dinner smaller than lunch for optimal fat loss and better sleep.
Weekly rotation: 3 days chicken, 2 days eggs, 2 days fish for variety and thyroid support.
Yoga is excellent. Add light walking after meals when possible for better digestion and metabolism.
